purpose: test whether a parameterised local cross-correlation over the pooled encoding's four subspaces opens the object-side selection that 19.2f/19.2g could not move

design.block: W_align 32x32 shared projection over four 32-d subspaces, cosine agreement at five offsets (-2..+2), 5x8 offset embedding, four extra W_hidden row inputs
design.graph_change: selection head only; binding, transport, pointer and decode untouched
design.loss: selection CE + inherited span term (no margin term)

arms.CE-only: parent head verbatim, 30 Adam updates, same batches

design.formal_eval: 192 examples, exact 27-byte action + EOS, free decode

gradient.meaning: the alignment tensors must carry gradient on the very first batch; a zero norm means the added block is unreachable from the loss (D16-8)

activity_precheck.gate_rule: non-zero gradient on every alignment tensor and need-fix share >= 0.20

rescue.meaning: reloaded bundle must reproduce 8/8 teacher-forced trajectories exactly

module_drift.message:
RuntimeError: Error(s) in loading state_dict for OrderedSelectionHead:
	Missing key(s) in state_dict: "W_align.weight".
module_drift.meaning: module drift must raise, never load quietly

decision.rule: full pass needs every gate and a positive Delta whose bootstrap interval excludes 0; otherwise an equivalent control arm means the gain is just the extra dose

six_cell_repricing.note: the six-cell rerun stays blocked until the owner rules; no branch of this package may imply a release

functional_items.item: 2 x 30 Adam selection updates (alignment head + CE-only control), batch 8, CE + span
two full 192-example decode passes (parent before, 19.2h after)
one 96-example new-description decode pass (CE-only control after)
two start-score extractions on the 96 new-description examples
activity pre-check: first-batch gradient norms + object-start need-fix share
payload, parent health, checkpoint dry-run, identity preflight, report

budget.rule: budget = functional item list x 3.3; 19.2f 100-150 vs 500.5 actual is the source

attribution_rules: gamma is the generation weight and 1 - gamma the copy weight
the alignment block is a graph change; identity must change and the new bundle stands
gain is reported as Delta = 19.2h - CE-only with a paired bootstrap interval
